name: Simsu
tagline: Fill in numbers to solve puzzles
blurb: Simsu is a basic Sudoku game.
description: Simsu is a basic Sudoku game. You can switch between filling in notes (pencil mode), or filling in answers (pen mode). To make it easier to see where to place numbers, you can highlight all instances of a number. You can also check your answers for correctness while playing. The game stores your current notes and answers, so that you can pick up where you left off the next time you play.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
